lint.nieuwTip: An empty drawing; Insert puts it as an @svg block at the cursor in the code.
lint.bewerkenTip: Open the @svg block the cursor is in; Update writes it back in the same place.
lint.vullingTip: Fill of rectangle, circle and closed polyline
lint.streepTip: Dashed line, for example for a centre line
lint.snappenTip: Points snap to the grid; hold Alt to draw freely.
lint.rastermaatTip: Spacing of the grid lines in px
lint.invoegenTip: Put the drawing as an @svg block at the cursor in the code
lint.bijwerkenTip: Replace the @svg block in the code with this drawing
lint.sluitenTip: Close the editor; anything not inserted or updated is discarded.
lint.schaalTip: Drawing scale of steel sections and timber, 1 : n on paper. A selected section takes it over.
lint.objectsnapTip: Object snap: a point jumps to end points, midpoints and centres of shapes, otherwise onto a nearby line. Alt: draw freely.
lint.orthoTip: Lines horizontal or vertical only (F8). Shift gives steps of 45°.
lint.kopierenTip: A copy of the selection, slightly offset (Ctrl+D)
lint.bibliotheekTip: All parametric symbols: steel sections and timber at true size, structural scheme and setting out. Pick one and click or drag in the drawing.

hint.selecteer: Click selects, Shift+click adds, drag a window. Type a command: m, co, ro, mi, sc, ar, e. Arrows nudge, Ctrl+C/V/D copies, Del removes.
hint.lijn: Drag from start to end, or click two points. Type 100,0 or a distance for the end point. Shift: at 45°.
hint.pijl: Drag from start to end, or click two points; the head goes at the end. Shift: at 45°.
hint.polylijn: Click the points one by one; double-click or Enter finishes, a click on the first point closes the shape.
hint.polylijnBezig: Click the next point · double-click or Enter: done · first point: closed · Esc: stop
hint.rechthoek: Drag from corner to opposite corner, or click both. Shift: square.
hint.cirkel: Click the centre and drag or click the radius.
hint.tekst: Click where the text starts and type it in the panel.
hint.maat: Click or drag the two measured points; then the mouse sets the side and the distance. Enter: default distance.
hint.boog: Click the start, a point on the arc and the end.
hint.boogBezig1: Click a point on the arc · Esc: stop
hint.boogBezig2: Click the end of the arc · Esc: stop
hint.schema: Drag from support to support: beam, pin and roller, distributed load and dimension appear in one go.
hint.symbool_punt: Click where the symbol goes; the preview snaps to end points and onto a beam. R rotates, F mirrors, Esc: done.
hint.symbool_lijn: Click or drag the start and the end; it snaps to end points and onto a beam. F: other side, Esc: done.
hint.symbool_vak: Drag or click from corner to opposite corner. Esc: done.
hint.maatAfstand: Move to the side of the dimension line and click the distance · Enter: default distance · Esc: stop
hint.tweedePunt: Click the next point or type 100,0 or a distance · Esc: stop

paneel.koppelUitleg: Every dimension is a number in px, or a link: a variable (b) or formula (h*scale) from the sheet. A linked dimension follows the calculation: when the input changes, the drawing changes.
paneel.eenheidUitleg: A value with a unit gives its number (200 mm becomes 200). To add a plain number to it, strip the unit first, for example b/(1 mm).
paneel.rekent: The sheet is calculating the links…
paneel.variabelen_one: {{count}} variable of the sheet is in the list of a link field.
paneel.variabelen_other: {{count}} variables of the sheet are in the list of a link field.
paneel.vastUitleg: The editor does not know this element. It stays in the drawing unchanged; you can delete it.
paneel.label: Label
paneel.tekstUitleg: {{o}}b{{s}} puts the value of b in the text; a formula works too: {{o}}h*scale{{s}}.
paneel.koppelKort: Leave the link empty for a fixed dimension in px.
paneel.koppelFout: Cannot be calculated at this point of the sheet: unknown name or error in the formula
paneel.koppelEenheid: Has a unit: only the number counts in the drawing
paneel.profielUitleg: From the section table. Your own number is fine, or a link to the sheet (a length in mm gives its number). On paper 1 mm is {{px}} px.
paneel.meerUitleg: Type a command or pick one in the ribbon: move, copy, rotate, mirror, scale, array or erase. Line colour and width in the ribbon apply to the whole selection.
paneel.plaatsUitleg: These choices apply to the next copy. R rotates, F mirrors, Esc stops.
paneel.alleGelijkTip: Ticked, a choice changes all equal symbols in this drawing, for example every HEB 240; otherwise only this one.

venster.nieuw: new · goes to the cursor in the code
venster.gewijzigd: Changed, not yet in the code

vlak.greepVast: Linked to the sheet: this dimension follows the input

melding.geladen: The @svg block of line {{regel}} is in the editor. Update writes it back there.
melding.geenBlok: The cursor is not in an @svg block. Put it in a block to edit that block.
melding.geenSvg: This @svg block has no <svg> element and cannot be edited.
melding.anderBlad: Another sheet: the drawing goes as a new block to the cursor of this sheet.
melding.ingevoegd: Inserted as an @svg block on line {{regel}}. Keep editing and choose Update, or close the editor to see the output.
melding.bijgewerkt: The @svg block on line {{regel}} has been updated.
melding.opnieuwIngevoegd: The original block is gone; the drawing is now a new block on line {{regel}}.

vraag.weggooien: The drawing has changes that are not yet in the code. Discard them?

symboolTip.staal: Cross-section of a steel section at true size (drawing scale). Pick the type; change size and type afterwards in the panel.
symboolTip.hout: Timber cross-section b × h at true size, with cross.
symboolTip.ligger: A member or beam as a thick line: drag from support to support.
symboolTip.oplegging: Pin, roller or fixed support: click the end of a beam.
symboolTip.puntlast: A point load with name and value; the value may be a variable from the sheet.
symboolTip.qlast: A distributed load over (part of) a beam, also trapezoidal.
symboolTip.moment: A moment, clockwise or anticlockwise, with name and value.
symboolTip.scharnier: A hinged (moment-free) connection in a beam.
symboolTip.veren: Soil springs under a beam or foundation: drag along the beam.
symboolTip.windverband: Bracing in a bay: cross or single diagonal.
symboolTip.stramien: A grid line with bubble and number or letter.
symboolTip.peil: A level mark with open or filled triangle.
symboolTip.paalpunt: The pile toe level in a frame; the level may come from the sheet.

veldTip.waarde: A number, or a variable or formula from the sheet (q_Ed). It follows the sheet: change the sheet and the drawing changes.
veldTip.waarde2: A number, or a variable or formula from the sheet
veldTip.niveau: A number, or a variable or formula from the sheet
veldTip.spiegel: On the other side of the line, or mirrored
veldTip.label: The name of the section, or your own text
veldTip.tekst: Empty: the name of the size
veldTip.hartlijn: Dash-dot centre lines through the middle
veldTip.aanzicht: Cross-section on one point; top and side view as a band between two points

cmd.leeg: Command (m, co, ro, mi, sc, ar, e):
cmd.selecteer: Select objects by click or window, Enter: continue

move.tip: Click the base point, then click or type the target (100,0 or a distance). Command m.
move.doel: Move, click the target or type 100,0 or a distance:

copy.tip: Base point, then one or more targets; Esc or Enter stops. Command co.
copy.doel: Copy, click a target or type 100,0 (Esc or Enter: done):

rotate.tip: Base point, then click the direction or type the angle in degrees (positive is clockwise). Command ro.
rotate.hoek: Rotate, click the direction or type the angle in degrees:

mirror.tip: Two points of the mirror line; then choose whether the original stays. Command mi.
mirror.basis: Mirror, click the first point of the mirror line:
mirror.doel: Mirror, click the second point of the mirror line:
mirror.wissen: Erase the original? y = yes, Enter = keep:

scale.tip: Base point, then type or click the factor. A section scales through its drawing scale. Command sc.
scale.factor: Scale, type the factor or click:

array.tip: Count, base point and the place of the last copy; the rest is spaced evenly in between. Command ar.
array.aantal: Array, type the count including the original (Enter: 3):
array.doel: Array, click the place of the last copy or type 100,0:

erase.tip: Remove the selection. Command e, or the Delete key.
